summary: A structured error whose kind is not in ERROR_KINDS loses its message: toCommandError returns kind probe with message "[object Object]"
evidence: api.ts:35-40 ERROR_KINDS separate from Rust enum; api.ts:42-52 guard rejects unknown kind; api.ts:59 String(err); commands.rs:17 kind is a free String
